title: Pentagon Releases Fifth Batch of UFO Files, Including Triangle Sightings and Cold War-Era Reports
description: Among the most striking materials in this latest release is a series of six videos documenting an encounter over the Gulf of Oman.

title: Colorado's 'shape-shifting' UFO disturbs locals as eerie footage emerges
description: A mysterious glowing orb hovered motionless in the Colorado sky for hours, sparking debate about its origins, with no official explanation provided.

title: 14,000 UFO sightings in Germany: reporting centre in Hesse investigates
